# Meeting-Pack Draft

## Summary
The team agreed on using a blue cover for the report. Alex will send the draft by Friday. Sam proposed changing the logo, but no decision was reached. The team acknowledged the need to review the budget, though no ownership or deadline was assigned for this task.

## Decisions
- Use the blue cover for the report. [0.03s]  
- Alex will send the draft on Friday. [3.19s]  

## Action items
| Task | Owner | Due date |
|------|-------|----------|
| Send the report draft | Alex | Friday [3.19s] |
| Review the budget | Not stated | Not stated |

## Unclear or unstated
- No decision was made regarding changing the logo, despite Sam’s suggestion. [5.63s]  
- No owner or deadline was assigned for the budget review. [12.31s]
